changelog.summary: Added The Festie Bible as a new book in the Library -- twelve field guides for every corner of the festival world (women, men, first-timers, LGBTQ+ attendees, artists, musicians, vendors, staff, harm reduction, camp leads, promoters, health & safety). Not fully live yet -- the book itself is built, but its own address is still pending a hosting decision.

The opening walkthrough is now a real guided tour -- it lights up one door at a time and tells you what is behind that one, then points out the coin and the music button, instead of dumping all five things into a single block of text. You can still tap a door at any point to skip ahead. Fixed the intro video cutting out after about three seconds: when a phone refuses to autoplay (Low Power Mode does this), the opening frame now holds as a title card you can tap to actually watch the clip, rather than giving up and fading away. The last two links still pointing at a raw netlify.app address -- The Portals and The Press -- now use noblefathercreations.com/portals and /press like everything else.

The corner button is now the actual Noble Father mark (a coin, not a generic icon). Music is back -- it starts softly once you choose a door, with a new button next to it to mute it any time. The tutorial now explains both buttons. Fixed every link on the page that was sending people to a bare netlify.app address instead of noblefathercreations.com/faith, /playbook, and the rest -- those addresses were never actually wired up before, so this is the first time they work.

The red button in the corner is now the Noble Father mark instead of the letters "NF". Fixed the title being sliced in half at the top of the opening screen: the door screen had more on it than fits a phone, so it had been scrolling inside its own frame. It now shows only what an entrance needs -- the mark, the title, one line, and the three doors -- and fits one screen on every phone, tablet and laptop, with the rest of the page returning the moment a door is chosen. "The Workshop" no longer wraps onto a second line under its door, and the last words of the link below the doors no longer hide behind the corner button. Visitors who have motion turned down, and phones in Low Power Mode (which blocks video outright), now get the opening frame held as a still title card instead of a blank screen, and the rest of the page keeps its gentle fades instead of switching off every animation.

A pass on the small stuff that adds up: every button and card now visibly presses when tapped or clicked, not just when hovered -- including the tutorial's own "Choose a door" button, which previously had no reaction to a click at all. Fixed a touch-device bug where the 3D book-tilt effect in the Library and Workshop could stay stuck in its tilted position after tapping a card, since phones fake a hover state on tap; it's now a real mouse-only effect with its own separate tap feedback. The four opening numbers (2 living tools, 8 books, and so on) now count in one after another instead of appearing all at once.

Fixed the intro video not playing and the tutorial not appearing on some phones; the 3 doors are now genuinely the only thing you can do until you pick one (scrolling past them no longer works); each door now visibly moves instead of only reacting to hover, which never fires on a touch screen. Also found and fixed a layout bug this same round introduced -- the door screen had grown taller than one view, and centering it on the doors pushed the title off the top of the screen with no way to scroll back to it; it now scrolls smoothly within its own frame instead. Typography rebuilt: the display serif now uses its full character at large sizes, headings have real weight contrast, and small print moved out of the monospace into something easier to read on a phone.

projects.localSourceNote: 2026-08-10: built from the 183-page FestieBible COMPLETE COLLECTION PDF (3 files, 60+61+62 pages) the user uploaded. Content extracted via OCR (the source PDF has broken font ligature mappings that silently drop letters from its own text stream -- OCR against the 300dpi render was used as ground truth instead) into content/festie-bible-data.json (12 guides, 149 scenarios, ~44k words of scenario prose). Rebuilt as a single self-contained HTML app (data-driven template, not hand-typed pages) using the hub design tokens (Fraunces/Hanken Grotesk/Space Mono, warm plum-black + brass palette) plus a 12-color persona accent per guide. Linked from the hub Library as VOL. X. NOT YET DEPLOYED -- needs a new Netlify site (or another hosting decision) before /festiebible resolves; see _redirects TODO in noble-father-catalogue._redirects.
